en: Data ingestion is simply the process of moving data from one place to another.
bounded vs unbounded; batch vs streaming; sync vs async; push vs pull vs poll; schema changes.
bounded data - divide data into chunks (segmenting it).
batch - fixed intervals (data size or time based)
Data management: make sure you're paying attention to Upstream schema changes and have a plan to handle those accordingly.
setup observability and monitoring for data pipelines.
Data architecture - build for resiliency and failure.
